game.name: Raiden IV (Japan)
game.desc: Raiden IV on Xbox 360 is, like its predecessors, an arcade shoot'em up. The Xbox version of the game has a number of additions, including the Xbox 360 mode in which you can find 8 difficulty modes. A Rush boss mode will allow you to face the game's bosses in a row, without the intermediate passages. Finally, a world ranking has been added to measure your talents in this version.
